changes.new: The TRTLLM NVFP4 arm supplies no custom per-token-scaling or quantizer-math override. Its selected SGLang helper omits the backend argument; pinned FlashInfer fp4_quantize defaults to CUDA and calls fp4_quantize_sm100 through the SM103 module. CuTeDSL-only math flags do not establish the selected CUDA path’s reciprocal or approximation behavior; no such low-level math claim is made. Fixed checkpoint global scale and runtime vector16 E4M3 block scales are established separately. The W4A16 opt-in also affects eligible dense NVFP4 linears under current defaults; it is not an isolated MoE-only precision change. Draft BF16 describes its MoE path, not every tensor. This reader checks sealed settings and accounting; actual native kernel/tactics/calibration, full terminal and preservation acceptance remain separate reviews.
